skill.summary: Etsy shop launch guide — policies, branding, first listings, SEO foundation, payment setup

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: expert guidance for setting up and optimizing your Etsy shop.

- Provides analysis of your shop setup and identifies areas for improvement
- Generates tailored implementation plans and prioritized action items
- Offers data-driven best practices and tool recommendations
- Delivers structured output with assessments, timelines, and KPIs to track progress
- No direct Etsy API integration; guidance is based on general best practices
